pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown contiguous regions exhibit highly irregular, stellate perimeters with jagged, high-frequency edge gradients. Patch shapes on the mid-flank are primarily multi-faceted polygons with deep micro-indentations, while neck patches appear larger and more horizontally elongated.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways form a continuous interconnected graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively uniform across the lateral flank, maintaining a narrow, high-contrast separation between dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a dense, upright silhouette with high-frequency vertical serrations along the neck and leading to the shoulder hump. Individual hair-group amplitudes create a jagged 1D contour against the background.
